ios.desc:
Reach peak freshness and flavor with your personal coffee organizer and bean tracker.

Coffee Library helps you track your coffee inventory with ease — whether you’re single-dosing or simply enjoying a good brew.

KEY FEATURES

• Coffee Journal — from origin details to tasting notes, record every detail of your favorite coffee beans 
• AI recognition — identify coffee information from a photo or a website to capture origin, roast, and notes instantly
• Resting reminder — log roast dates and set resting windows for peak freshness
• Dose tracker — keep tabs on frozen or unfrozen doses so you never lose track
• Smart labeling — use NFC stickers to easily identify and track for effortless organization

WHY COFFEE LIBRARY?
• Helps you build a personal archive of your coffee journey and brewing notes as you grow into your hobby
• Gives a clear view of your coffee stash without digging through jars and bags
• Turns your freezer into a living coffee bean library where every jar is identified
• Helps you find the right window for a perfect brew

Download Coffee Library today and brew with confidence!

Privacy Policy: https://coffeelibrary.app/privacypolicy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
I discovered the world of specialty coffee last year, fell into the rabbit hole and am now building a coffee journal and bean tracking app called Coffee Library (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/coffee-library/id6664071528?uo=4).

Probably the best way to develop your taste and understand the spectrum of different coffees available is to do comparative tasting aka try a small number of coffees in parallel to compare and contrast. I was having trouble finding tasting sets so I started freezing a little portion of every coffee bag I bought to create a collection for doing these tastings at home.

I needed something to keep track of them all (as well as my tasting notes in general) so instead of using a spreadsheet I built a full app for it. The app supports NFC-tagged containers which I've found to make my workflow a whole lot easier.

I also set up an online store to sell the NFC-equipped single-dosing tubes: https://store.coffeelibrary.app
Planning on adding more containers that work well with the app in the future.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (February 2025)
